title: GTA 6 Latest Community Leak Details Vehicle Mechanics, Physics, and Wanted System
description: A massive new leak breakdown on Reddit r/GTA6 details unconfirmed gameplay mechanics for GTA 6, including car maintenance, physics, and a 6-star wanted system.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Latest Community Leak Details Vehicle Mechanics, Physics, and Wanted System

As the gaming community eagerly counts down the days, discussion surrounding Rockstar Games' upcoming blockbuster *Grand Theft Auto VI* continues to dominate online spaces. Recently, a comprehensive breakdown of purported game mechanics emerged on the r/GTA6 Reddit community (unconfirmed rumor). While metadata suggests some source footage dates back to 2023, the sheer level of detail discussed has sparked intense speculation among fans.

### Deep Vehicle and Survival Mechanics

According to the community roundup, *GTA 6* appears to be leaning heavily into simulation elements. The leak points toward a dedicated car mechanical maintenance system—potentially requiring players to care for their vehicles in a manner similar to horses in *Red Dead Redemption 2*—along with car fuel mechanics. Additionally, vehicle damage and environmental interaction have received significant upgrades:

* **Damage and Scratches:** Cars are built more robustly, featuring a detailed paint scratch and spark system upon contact with other vehicles.
* **Tire Smoke:** The leaks suggest the game features the most realistic car tire smoke seen in any current title.
* **Interactivity:** Tailgates can be manually opened or closed, a feature that may extend to standard doors and hoods.
* **Storage:** Dedicated systems for car object storage and weapon storage.

### Character Stats and Advanced Physics

On the character and world-interaction front, the leaks report the return of familiar systems alongside technical leaps. An **honor system**, a **stamina system**, and a separated **cash on hand and cash at home/vault system** are reportedly included. Side activities, such as playing basketball, can reportedly increase character attributes like focus. Furthermore, water and object physics have been elevated; for example, a basketball can realistically roll into a lake, float, and dynamically react with the water, complemented by denser vegetation and ray-traced real-time reflections.

Jason can also take hit damage during crashes, with extreme accidents potentially proving fatal, mirroring prior franchise entries. Leaked footage is reportedly running at 60 fps.

### The Return of the 6-Star Wanted Level and Enhanced NPC AI

One of the most discussed points is the return of the **6-Star Wanted Level**. When wanted, three red icons appear, implying the police track whether the car is known, the clothes are known, and the face is known. Cops can also be seen sitting on the roadside conducting speed traps or traffic enforcement.

NPC behavior and animations have similarly evolved:

* NPC drivers realistically dodge to avoid crashing into Jason's car.
* NPCs on bicycles are present in the world.
* Improved vehicle exit animations for both NPCs and Jason.
* Enhanced mutual eye contact and interaction during collisions.
* The classic **Greet, Antagonize, Defuse, Threaten** dialogue system returns.
* Fight animations show noticeable improvements over *Red Dead Redemption 2*.

Additionally, a full leaked map is reportedly circulating, which is described as nearly spot-on except for the northern regions, setting the stage for future community mapping projects.

### Editor's Take

While these leaked details paint an exciting picture of what Rockstar might be developing, it is crucial to remember that this information is entirely unconfirmed and stems from community reports. Players should approach these leaks with healthy skepticism while maintaining excitement for future official updates from Rockstar Games.
